subject: Human Evolution
title: Homo floresiensis: The Hobbit
description: A quick, practical guide to Homo floresiensis: The Hobbit.

hook.text: On the island of Flores, a one-meter-tall human species hunted pygmy elephants until just 50,000 years ago.

buildup.text: Homo floresiensis had a brain the size of a chimpanzee's—yet made stone tools and possibly used fire.

discovery.text: Island dwarfism—where species shrink on isolated islands with limited resources—may explain their size.

twist.text: Their ancestor is debated: a dwarfed Homo erectus, or a much older lineage that reached the island.

climax.text: Until recently, at least three human species shared the planet—we weren't alone for most of our history.

punchline.text: Tiny island humans defied every expectation.

quiz.question: What likely explains the small size of Homo floresiensis?
options: They were children of Homo sapiens
